assets.why_not_reuse: Opening the walls would expose neighbouring host rooms (Breitling to the south, Secret Collection to the east). A Reflector-style portal pass shows a separate landscape scene with exact parallax. Reusable by any room that needs a view; adapts bellagio/world-runtime/geo-terrain.js ideas.
No course-profile object existed; the NOR fjord relief is decorative ridges, not a profile with sourced anchors.
assets.note: Stacked contour model: one slate slab per 100 m of height, oak every 500 m, a light line tracing the profile.

Board-formed concrete and glulam hall, cold lap pool with caustics, ferry ramp, pace clock, Nordic sauna, swim shelf, wheel rack and helmet, strength corner, crew table, routine board, finisher tops, sun shafts. Pool water and floor approaches adapted from NOR // 3.
Desktop only, inside the portal scene; the east terrain sits on layer 1 so the mirror skips it. Phones use a plain water material.
Baked at load by marching each vertex toward the sun over the heightfield; replaces a runtime shadow pass that failed intermittently in headless Chrome.
